blockingFindings.summary: Assistant tool calls and tool results must be persisted and replayed in causal order.
Compaction must be transactional and leave history unchanged on failure or cancellation.
One cancellation scope must cover preflight, streaming, approvals, compaction, storage, and sandbox cleanup.
Plan-mode capabilities must be immutable for the duration of an active turn.
Security contract tests must pass without skipped cases on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
Extension-host, webview, SCM, installed-VSIX, fake-server, and live llama.cpp release checks must pass.
